kvkk.title: Privacy Notice
kvkk.p1: As RKYS Dashboard, we act as the data controller when processing your personal data under applicable data protection law.
kvkk.p2: The name, email and business information you provide when creating an account are processed to deliver the service, for billing, and to handle your support requests.
kvkk.p3: Your data is retained only for as long as necessary to provide the service and is not shared with third parties except where legally required.
kvkk.p4: To exercise your data protection rights, you can contact us at support@rkys.app.

cerez.title: Cookie Policy
cerez.p1: This site uses essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember your preferences.
cerez.p2: Beyond essential cookies, optional analytics cookies may be used for usage statistics.
cerez.p3: You can delete or block cookies at any time from your browser settings; this may cause some features to stop working.

sozlesme.title: Terms of Use
sozlesme.p1: This agreement governs the relationship between businesses ("tenants") using the RKYS Dashboard service and the platform.
sozlesme.p2: The service is provided "as is"; after the 14-day trial period, you must subscribe to a plan to continue using it.
sozlesme.p3: The tenant is solely responsible for the accuracy and legal compliance of the data belonging to its own customers and staff.
sozlesme.p4: The platform reserves the right to suspend an account in case of misuse or payment delay.

veriSilme.title: Data Deletion Request
veriSilme.p1: You have the right to request the permanent deletion of your account and all data belonging to your business.
veriSilme.p2: A deletion request is irreversible; once received, our team will delete your data, subject to legally required retention periods.
veriSilme.cta: To delete your account, go to Settings → Delete My Account in your admin panel.
